statements.t: We expect to continue to experience increased competition, which may result in reduced advertising demand, and could adversely affect our revenue growth, pricing, business, financial condition, and results of operations.

Our revenue, particularly in North America, has further been impacted by platform policy changes and restrictions that affected our targeting, measurement, and optimization capabilities, and in turn our ability to measure the effectiveness of advertisements on our services.
In the first quarter of 2027, among other changes to our user metrics, we plan to transition to global MAU as our primary audience metric.

• Adjusted EBITDA excludes stock-based compensation expense and payroll and other tax expense related to stock-based compensation, which have been, and will continue to be for the foreseeable future, significant recurring expenses in our business and an important part of our compensation strategy; and

risks.t: changes in interest and foreign currency exchange rates
other risks and uncertainties have in the past and may continue to cause logistical challenges
which in turn may cause our advertisers to halt or decrease advertising spending on our platform

estimates.t: We prepare our financial statements in accordance with GAAP.

statements.t: Additional information will be made available in our periodic report that will be filed with the SEC for the period covered by this press release and other filings that we make from time to time with the SEC.
Beginning with our Quarterly Report on Form 10-Q to be filed for the first quarter of 2027, we plan to transition to global MAU as our primary audience metric.
Daily engagement has historically been stable as a percentage of monthly engagement, but we do not intend to optimize Snapchat around daily use at the expense of long-term value for our community.

Beginning in the first quarter of 2027, we plan to update the definition of MAU to include any registered and logged-in Snapchat user who visits at least one Snapchat-branded product through our applications or websites, which under the updated definition will include users who access our products through Apple Watch.
Beginning in the first quarter of 2027, we plan to define ARPU as quarterly revenue divided by global MAU reported for the quarter.
We will also no longer report regional ARPU.
